findings.claim: host-firewall.md still says configure_network.yml is the last step of just bootstrap; configure_dns.yml now runs after it

verdict.text: The move is correct.
The play in `configure_dns.yml` matches the block from 4ae98ed7 byte for byte, apart from the blank separator line.
`configure_network.yml` is back to its state at 4ae98ed7^1.
`just bootstrap` runs the new playbook last.
ADR 0033 changes only in its sources line and the appended Correction.
One page the change made false was missed: the host-firewall component still calls `configure_network.yml` the last step of `just bootstrap`.
It is a one-cell doc fix, so the label is fix.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: stamp green 10112637a4a72980727af9aea8bea2deab4b0a047f125721d208359456bd70ca.
pre_commit, cli_tests and rows r1 to r5 all pass.
Move fidelity: diffed lines 47 onward of `4ae98ed7:configure_network.yml` against lines 2 onward of `configure_dns.yml`.
The only difference is the blank line that separated the play from the firewall plays.
The header comment still reads right on its own: it names the two hosts, why, the `searches=home` trap and the Bifrost restart, and it never refers to the firewall file.
The new file opens with `---` like every other playbook.
r1: `cli/tests/test_bootstrap_dns_fallback.py` reads `PLAYBOOK`, which now points at `configure_dns.yml`.
`dns_play()` asserts exactly one play writes the drop-in, and the three tests pin hosts, server order, options and `searches=home`.
If the file is missing or the play is gone, the test fails.
r2 and r3: reran by the stamp.
r3's grep keeps only task lines, so a second task would fail the string compare.
r4: justfile line 50 runs `configure_dns.yml` after `configure_network.yml`.
r6 (judgment): `git diff main` on ADR 0033 shows one hunk at line 11 (the sources resource) and one hunk that only adds lines after the old last line (line 56).
The Decision paragraph still names `configure_network.yml`.
That is right for a stable record, and the Correction explains the move.
Leftover references: grepped `.okf`, `docs`, `bootstrap`, `cli` and README for `configure_network`, "network playbook", playbook counts, `90-dns-fallback` and "last step".

Every other `configure_network.yml` mention is about ufw ports (deployment-layers, firebat, jetson, ubuntu, the radxa and orangepi firewall tables, placement, tailscale-subnet-router, the breakglass runbook and its tests).
Those stay true.
`docs/` and `bootstrap/README.md` hold no reference.
The bootstrap component's "ten playbooks" matches the ten files and the ten justfile lines.
Nothing still refers to the old source id `network-playbook`.
f1: `.okf/components/host-firewall.md:35`, the Runs column of the Ansible `firewall` row, says "`configure_network.yml`, the last step of `just bootstrap`".
That was true on main and is false now, because `configure_dns.yml` runs after it.
The fix is to drop "the last step" or replace it with "step 9 of `just bootstrap`".
Not blocking because the fix is plain text, but the operator asked for no stale references, so fix it before commit.
The radxa and orangepi node pages still cite `configure_network.yml` in their firewall tables, but no longer list it as a source.
That matches their state before dns-fallback, so `kmctl review due` would not flag them when firewall ports change.
This is not a regression from this ticket.
